skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Romance Overflow
skins.content: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Romance Overflow. Elaborate dress Hibiscus wore to promote a sightseeing train. Brilliant purples, beautiful hem, and delicate ornamentation—a perfect union of elegance and romance.
skins.usage: One of Hibiscus the Purifier's casual outfits.
skins.quote: It's true that Hibiscus is happy to wear such pretty clothes, but what makes her even happier is being afforded the opportunity as both a Sarkaz and an Infected. Their struggles have meant something, she thinks.
